title: Chat view with the "show terminal" switch as the agent tab body
summary: Resumed the needs-human pull request after the owner decided that Use it sends exactly what the message box shows. Agent tabs can now show a chat view (bubbles, clickable answers, permission buttons, a message box, a show-terminal switch), opt-in through GRILLO_AGENT_RUNTIME=chat while the terminal stays the default per the PRD.
friction: A PRD change merged mid-story (terminal stays the default) contradicted an acceptance criterion; the dev found it only on its final merge of main, and the issue body had to be rewritten during review
